package.description: Hardware sensors for PowerToys Command Palette via PawnIO/LibreHardwareMonitor.

en-US.description: Hardware sensors for PowerToys Command Palette via PawnIO/LibreHardwareMonitor.
en-US.longDescription: Live CPU, GPU, disk temperatures and usage. Pin readings to the Dock. Sticky expand-only ASCII trend charts and an offline HTML dashboard. Real CPU Tctl via an optional SYSTEM helper over a named pipe (zero disk writes).
en-US.name: Hardware Monitor (PawnIO)

zh-CN.description: 通过 PawnIO/LibreHardwareMonitor 为 PowerToys 命令面板提供硬件传感器读数。
zh-CN.longDescription: 实时显示 CPU/GPU/硬盘温度与占用，可固定到命令面板快捷栏。支持只增不减的 ASCII 趋势图与离线 HTML 看板；CPU 真实温度通过可选的 SYSTEM 助手经命名管道提供（零写盘）。
zh-CN.name: 硬件监视器 (PawnIO)
